cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a woven cotton head-dress/mask with strip-woven cloth, appliquéd facial features and a twisted cotton "beard" with limb-like extensions, consistent with Tiv ritual masking traditions using narrow-strip woven cotton textiles. This is a clear, whole example of a handmade garment/mask object plausible for the Tiv or neighboring Nigerian groups.

physical.title: head-dress
physical.summary: Head-dress (with mask): composed of 13 plain woven cotton narrow strips: light and dark blue warps and wefts producing a dog tooth pattern: narrow strips hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge made of cotton. The mask: eyes, nose, mouth composed of dyed red, green and blue cotton: the face is surrounded by a 'beard' of twisted natural coloured cotton: limbs(?) dyed light blue, dark blue and purple warps and dyed dark blue wefts forming warp stripes edged by natural coloured cotton. Finished by an unworked hem.
